inputs.checklistItemText: Trees proposed within 10 lateral feet of overhead electric utility pole
inputs.question: On the landscape plan, are utility pole locations shown? If so, are there any trees (shown as circular symbols) placed within approximately 10 feet (at the plan scale of 1"=20') from any pole locations?

output.reasoning: The agent question asks whether trees are placed within approximately 10 feet of utility poles at a specific plan scale (1"=20'), which is a direct distance/clearance measurement task. Although the question begins with a presence check (are poles shown?), the core compliance verification requires measuring the lateral distance between trees and poles against the 10-foot threshold.
